noob.caption: #FFD23F
noob.acting: bright, fast, cheerful cartoon character, impulsive and oblivious, great comic timing

steve.caption: #3FE0D0
steve.acting: calm, low, dry and deadpan; a practical survivor who rarely raises his voice

patch.caption: #B6F0FF
patch.acting: calm, literal, slightly too quiet; announces disasters politely

null.caption: #FF3BD4
null.acting: slow, cold, completely emotionless, like a machine announcing a verdict

overlays.next_title: THE FIRST PORTAL WAS A TRAP
overlays.question: WHICH ONE SHOULDN'T BE IN THIS WORLD?

overlays.text: Theory: ...one of them shouldn't be in a world...
overlays.highlight: one of them shouldn't be in a world

events.name: noob_wait
events.direction_text: [quick, to the audience, half-whisper, like pausing a movie] Okay, wait. Before THAT happens...

events.name: noob_hi
events.text: Hi, new people! You have no idea what's going on.
events.direction_text: [bright, waving at the camera, way too cheerful] Hi, new people! You have no idea what's going on.

events.name: noob_same
events.direction_text: [small beat, then shrugging, honest] ...Same.

events.name: steve_eight
events.text: Eight episodes of problems. Patch. Show them.
events.direction_text: [dry, deadpan, tired] Eight episodes of problems. Patch. Show them.

events.name: patch_archive
events.direction_text: [calm, simple, polite] Rewinding. To the very start.

events.name: noob_falling
events.text: That's us. Falling. Spoiler: it's the end.
events.direction_text: [casual, pointing, unbothered] That's us. Falling. Spoiler: it's the end.

events.name: steve_beginning
events.direction_text: [dry correction, instantly] It's the beginning.

events.name: noob_deep
events.text: It's the end AND the beginning. Deep.
events.direction_text: [pretending to be wise, slow] It's the end AND the beginning. Deep.

events.name: noob_ep1
events.text: Episode one. I punched a tree. It floated.
events.direction_text: [proud, quick, like it's a big achievement] Episode one. I punched a tree. It floated.
events.solo_text: Episode one. I punched a tree. It floated.

events.name: steve_sky
events.direction_text: [low, serious, slower] Then the sky cracked open...

events.name: patch_eye
events.direction_text: [quiet, careful, ominous] ...and something looked down at us.

events.name: noob_whatisit
events.direction_text: [scared whisper, but clear] What IS that thing?

events.name: patch_unknown
events.direction_text: [calm, honest, quiet but clear] Unknown. But it saw everything.

events.name: noob_hieye
events.direction_text: [tiny, nervous, waving up at the sky] ...Hi, eye.

events.name: steve_plan
events.text: So I made a plan. Leave, before that eye came back.
events.direction_text: [practical, explaining, a little proud] So I made a plan. Leave, before that eye came back.

events.name: steve_steps
events.text: Portal home. Three steps. Nobody touches anything.
events.direction_text: [firm, counting the steps] Portal home. Three steps. Nobody touches anything.

events.name: noob_button
events.direction_text: [defensive, instantly, loud] There was a BUTTON!

events.name: steve_three
events.direction_text: [flat, still hurt about it] The plan lasted three seconds.

events.name: noob_record
events.direction_text: [cheerful, celebrating] Three seconds. New record!

events.name: patch_waved
events.text: Then, inside the portal... something waved back.
events.direction_text: [quiet, slow, ominous] Then, inside the portal... something waved back.

events.name: noob_polite
events.text: I waved first! I was being polite!
events.direction_text: [defensive, quick] I waved first! I was being polite!

events.name: steve_watching
events.text: First the eye. Then that. Something was watching us.
events.direction_text: [low, serious, putting it together] First the eye. Then that. Something was watching us.

events.name: noob_dragon
events.text: We put a dragon in an obby!
events.direction_text: [excited, proud] We put a dragon in an obby!

events.name: steve_you
events.text: YOU put a dragon in an obby.
events.direction_text: [dry, correcting him] YOU put a dragon in an obby.

events.name: noob_block
events.text: Then the dragon glitched... and dropped a weird block!
events.direction_text: [excited, telling a story] Then the dragon glitched... and dropped a weird block!

events.name: steve_exist
events.text: A block that shouldn't exist. Nobody knows why.
events.direction_text: [dry, serious] A block that shouldn't exist. Nobody knows why.

events.name: noob_touched
events.direction_text: [proud, matter-of-fact, like it was obvious] So I touched it.

events.name: patch_grew
events.text: It grew bigger... every time he died.
events.direction_text: [calm, quiet, clear] It grew bigger... every time he died.

events.name: noob_helping
events.direction_text: [defensive, instantly] I was HELPING!

events.name: patch_arrived
events.text: And then I arrived. Things improved.
events.direction_text: [calm, quietly pleased with itself] And then I arrived. Things improved.

events.name: steve_weirder
events.direction_text: [deadpan] Things got weirder.

events.name: patch_improvement
events.direction_text: [calm, after a tiny pause, certain] ...Weirder is an improvement.

events.name: noob_creative
events.text: Then the block gave me CREATIVE MODE! I built everything!
events.direction_text: [excited, arms wide open] Then the block gave me CREATIVE MODE! I built everything!

events.name: steve_list
events.text: A giant statue of himself. A duck. A door to nowhere.
events.direction_text: [deadpan, listing, unimpressed] A giant statue of himself. A duck. A door to nowhere.

events.name: noob_close
events.direction_text: [cheerful, instantly] Close enough!

events.name: patch_belong
events.text: None of it belonged in this world. So the world started deleting it...
events.direction_text: [calm, serious, explaining clearly] None of it belonged in this world. So the world started deleting it...

events.name: patch_worse
events.direction_text: [quieter, heavy, but clear] ...and everything around it.

events.name: noob_duck
events.direction_text: [small, sad, sincere] ...RIP duck.

events.name: noob_dontlike
events.direction_text: [small, uneasy, but clear] ...I don't like that guy.

events.name: steve_nobody
events.direction_text: [low, serious] Nobody likes that guy.

events.name: patch_behind
events.text: Every time he respawns... something stays behind.
events.direction_text: [quiet, careful, slightly ominous, clear] Every time he respawns... something stays behind.

events.name: noob_alot
events.direction_text: [worried, realising] I respawn a LOT.

events.name: steve_sense
events.text: So some things started making sense...
events.direction_text: [slow, thinking it through] So some things started making sense...

events.name: noob_bigger
events.direction_text: [cutting in, worried] ...and the questions got WAY bigger.

events.name: noob_where
events.text: Like... where do all the old me's GO?
events.direction_text: [nervous, really asking] Like... where do all the old me's GO?

events.name: steve_howmany
events.text: And how many times have we done this?
events.direction_text: [quiet, serious] And how many times have we done this?

events.name: patch_counting
events.direction_text: [calm, too quiet, but clear] ...I stopped counting.

events.name: noob_you
events.text: And YOU. Built. The FIRST portal.
events.direction_text: [slow, accusing, one word at a time] And YOU. Built. The FIRST portal.

events.name: steve_next
events.direction_text: [dry, avoiding eye contact, quick] ...Patch. Next slide.

events.name: noob_dontnext
events.direction_text: [outraged, instantly] Don't 'next slide' me!

events.name: patch_lastslide
events.direction_text: [calm, polite] ...That was the last slide.

events.name: patch_theories
events.direction_text: [calm, mysterious] The observers have theories.

events.name: noob_oneofus
events.text: One of us shouldn't be in this world...
events.direction_text: [slowly reading it, then suspicious] One of us shouldn't be in this world...

events.name: noob_itsyou
events.text: It's you. You're ALWAYS holding a pickaxe.
events.direction_text: [accusing, certain, pointing] It's you. You're ALWAYS holding a pickaxe.

events.name: steve_dying
events.direction_text: [dry, firing back instantly] You're always DYING.

events.name: noob_which
events.direction_text: [small, nervous, turning to Patch] ...Patch? Which one?

events.name: patch_nocomment
events.direction_text: [calm, quiet, mysterious, a tiny smile in the voice] No comment.

events.name: patch_budget
events.text: Good news. The finale has a budget.
events.direction_text: [calm, polite, a little proud] Good news. The finale has a budget.

events.name: noob_what
events.direction_text: [confused] A what?

events.name: patch_upgrade
events.text: Upgrade starting. Please do not move.
events.direction_text: [calm, like an airport announcement] Upgrade starting. Please do not move.

events.name: steve_hair
events.direction_text: [stunned, quiet, touching it] ...I have hair. Real hair.

events.name: noob_beautiful
events.direction_text: [sincere, almost crying] It's beautiful.

events.name: steve_dont
events.direction_text: [flat, embarrassed] Don't.

events.name: noob_textured
events.direction_text: [confused, looking at his arms] Why do I feel... textured?

events.name: steve_welcome
events.direction_text: [dry, a tiny smile] Welcome to Minecraft.

events.name: noob_smile
events.direction_text: [shocked, delighted, shouting] PATCH CAN SMILE?!

events.name: patch_always
events.text: I always could. Now you can see it.
events.direction_text: [calm, warm] I always could. Now you can see it.

events.name: noob_woah
events.direction_text: [amazed, quiet, looking around] Woooah.

events.name: steve_nice
events.direction_text: [impressed despite himself, low] Okay. That's... nice.

events.name: noob_him
events.text: Do you think HE got upgraded too?
events.direction_text: [casual at first, then the thought lands] Do you think HE got upgraded too?

events.name: steve_quiet
events.direction_text: [whispering, tense] ...Why did it go quiet?

events.name: patch_too
events.direction_text: [calm, polite, very quiet] He got upgraded too.

events.name: noob_run
events.direction_text: RUUUUUN!

events.name: noob_finale
events.direction_text: [running, shouting back at the camera, scared but cheerful] SEE YOU IN THE FINALE!

events.name: steve_stop
events.direction_text: [running, out of breath, shouting] STOP TALKING AND RUN!
